newsitem.title: USA: Meredith plans personal finance quarterly.
newsitem.headline: Meredith plans personal finance quarterly.

text.p: Meredith Corp said Monday it would launch a new quarterly magazine on personal finance, Better Homes and Gardens Family Money, with an initial press run of 250,000.
The publication will be available on newsstands and through subscription sales in the summer of 1997. A cover price has yet to be set.
Meredith said the magazine would cover such topics as basic retirement planning, college savings plans and expense management.

Metropolitan Life Insurance Co will sponsor a special edition of the new magazine for its customers. Customized MetLife editions will feature Life Advice, an existing MetLife eudcational program providing information on everyday financial matters.
Meredith, a multimedia company, operates television stations and publishes Better Homes and Gardens, Ladies' Home Journal and Country Home, among other titles.
